findings.evidence: Lines 125–128 prove `Module.finrank K (hyperbolicModel K n) = n`, while line 147 already needs this characteristic equation internally.
findings.fix: Make it a public `@[simp]` theorem (with the canonical model-oriented name).
findings.issue: The dimension theorem `finrank_hyperbolicModel` is private, so consumers cannot use the advertised fact that the model has dimension `n` without unfolding all three abbreviations.

findings.evidence: Lines 85–122 prove the required separating property, and lines 137–143 convert it to `(hyperbolicModelForm K n).Nondegenerate`, but neither property is exported.
findings.fix: Expose a public theorem such as `hyperbolicModelForm_nondegenerate`; keep the associated/separating-left implementation helper private and reuse the public result in the decomposition.
findings.issue: Nondegeneracy of `hyperbolicModelForm` has no public theorem; the separating-left proof is private and the result is reconstructed only locally inside `hyperbolicDecomposition`.

summary: The model’s public API omits its two defining structural properties, forcing consumers to unfold the representation or reconstruct internal proofs.
